prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1449; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The collision was a head-on impact caused by your insured crossing into our client's lane. Although the speed of the vehicles at impact was relatively low, the force of the collision was sufficient to cause significant soft tissue injury to our client's neck and upper back, commonly diagnosed as whiplash.

Since the accident, our client has experienced persistent neck pain, stiffness, reduced range of motion, and recurring headaches. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, diagnostic imaging, physical therapy, and prescribed medication. Our client's treating providers have documented ongoing limitations that affect daily activities, sleep, and work responsibilities.

Liability is clear. The police report and independent witness statements both indicate your insured was solely responsible for the collision. There is no reasonable basis for disputing fault.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all bodily injury claims arising from this accident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
